economia|asia.title: Yen sinks after BoJ raises rates to highest level since 1995
economia|asia.summary: The yen weakened after the Bank of Japan raised rates to their highest level since 1995. Authorities warn of potential further currency intervention following the central bank's move.

economia|asia.title: China Opens Probes Into Four Online Travel Booking Platforms
economia|asia.summary: China launched investigations into four online travel booking platforms over suspected unfair competition practices. The probes examine potential violations affecting market fairness and merchant rights.

economia|asia.title: Turkey moves to calm nervous markets after fund crisis sparks selloff
economia|asia.summary: Turkey moves to stabilize nervous markets after a fund crisis triggered significant asset selloffs. Authorities implement measures to restore investor confidence and market stability.

economia|europa.title: ECB Consumer Expectations Survey results – August 2026
economia|europa.summary: The ECB released its Consumer Expectations Survey results for August 2026. The data provides insights into consumer sentiment and inflation expectations across the eurozone.

economia|europa.title: Bank of Japan raises rates and accelerates tightening
economia|europa.summary: The Bank of Japan raised rates to 1.25% as expected and accelerates tightening pace. Quarterly rate increases will continue according to the central bank's guidance.

economia|europa.title: Lagarde vuelve a sugerir la opción de abandonar el BCE antes de tiempo: “Veremos”
economia|europa.summary: Lagarde sugiere nuevamente la posibilidad de abandonar el BCE antes de finalizar su mandato. España reclama un rol importante en el próximo órgano de gobierno de la entidad monetaria.

economia|europa.title: Alemania y los frugales rechazan de plano la propuesta española para el presupuesto europeo
economia|europa.summary: Alemania y países frugales rechazan la propuesta española para el presupuesto europeo. Exigen recortes de cientos de miles de millones y se niegan a considerar el plan de reestructuración de fondos.

economia|america.title: FirstFT: Venezuela nears deal to transfer $4bn gold reserve to New York
economia|america.summary: Venezuela nears a deal to transfer its $4 billion gold reserve to New York. Top Republican warns Hispanic voters feel betrayed by Trump amid Wall Street trading decline.

economia|america.title: Economía argentina pierde impulso y amenaza reelección de Milei
economia|america.summary: Argentina's economy loses momentum, threatening Milei's reelection prospects. Economic slowdown poses challenges for the administration's political future.

economia|america.title: Colombia’s New Finance Chief Woos Wall Street After Budget Shock
economia|america.summary: Colombia's new finance chief woos Wall Street investors after budget shock. Officials expressed optimism that the austerity plan will gain Congressional approval.

politica|asia.title: Trump signs sweeping Russia sanctions bill
politica|asia.summary: Trump signed a sweeping Russia sanctions bill named after late Senator Lindsey Graham. The legislation supports continued aid for Ukraine against Russian aggression.

politica|asia.title: Koizumi and U.S. defense chief Hegseth agree to boost security cooperation
politica|asia.summary: Japan's Defense Minister Koizumi and U.S. Defense Secretary Hegseth agreed to boost security cooperation. The officials have conducted eight rounds of talks since assuming their positions.

politica|asia.title: Seoul affirms U.S. investment pledges, intent to help with Strait of Hormuz free passage
politica|asia.summary: Seoul affirmed U.S. investment pledges and intent to help maintain free passage through the Strait of Hormuz. South Korea ruled out sending troops to the strategic waterway.

politica|asia.title: North Korean hackers behind crypto thefts across 100 countries, including Japan
politica|asia.summary: North Korean hackers called WaterPlum targeted crypto assets across 100 countries, including Japan. The group infected over 30,000 devices with malware between December and July.

politica|asia.title: Death toll from attack at police HQ in Pakistan rises to 31
politica|asia.summary: Death toll from an attack on a police headquarters in Kohat, Pakistan rose to 31. Attackers stormed the Old Police Lines complex on September 18.

politica|europa.title: Trump announces security deal with Greenland, ending dispute with Denmark, EU and NATO
politica|europa.summary: Trump announced a security deal with Greenland, resolving disputes with Denmark, the EU, and NATO. The U.S. will establish a significant military presence in the Arctic territory.

politica|europa.title: German chancellor Friedrich Merz faces mounting criticism ahead of September 20 regional elections
politica|europa.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz faces mounting criticism ahead of September 20 regional elections. The far-right AfD party is expected to continue gaining support in upcoming votes.

politica|europa.title: Iran's 'new Hezbollah:' How powerful are the Houthis now?
politica|europa.summary: The Houthis have grown significantly in importance to Iran's regional strategy following victories in Yemen. The group is now considered a powerful component of Iran's geopolitical influence.

politica|europa.title: Why Macron is warning against risk of Russian hybrid warfare in France
politica|europa.summary: Macron warned against Russian hybrid warfare risks in France during a confidential briefing. He gathered presidential candidates and party leaders to discuss evolving security threats.

politica|europa.title: Los ataques atribuidos a Rusia se multiplican en Europa y llegan a las puertas de la OTAN
politica|europa.summary: Ataques atribuidos a Rusia se multiplican en Europa cerca de fronteras de la OTAN. Macron ordena proteger infraestructuras críticas francesas tras seis semanas de incidentes.

politica|america.title: US and Denmark reach deal over Greenland after Trump annexation threats
politica|america.summary: The U.S. and Denmark reached a deal over Greenland after Trump's annexation threats. Trump says the agreement grants the U.S. permanent control over Greenland's security needs.

politica|america.title: Judge says Trump can't demolish Kennedy Center. And, lawsuits target voter intimidation
politica|america.summary: A federal judge ruled Trump cannot demolish the Kennedy Center without 30 days' notice. Recent lawsuits seek to prevent armed federal officers from voter intimidation activities.

politica|america.title: Syrian regime planned American journalist's kidnapping for weeks
politica|america.summary: Syrian regime planned American journalist Austin Tice's kidnapping for weeks, new reporting reveals. The abduction was orchestrated by the Syrian government, not a spontaneous act.

politica|america.title: Could US pull one-third of troops from Europe? What that would mean
politica|america.summary: The U.S. Pentagon reportedly considers reducing military footprint across Europe by one-third. The proposal would significantly alter America's defense posture on the continent.

tecnologia|america.title: AI hallucination of Chinese nuclear components almost led to US military attack
tecnologia|america.summary: An AI hallucination of Chinese nuclear components nearly triggered a U.S. military response. The incident highlights risks as military AI adoption continues accelerating.

tecnologia|america.title: The specter of AI-enabled bioweapons is a wake-up call for biotech
tecnologia|america.summary: AI company leaders warn that their technology poses bioweapon risks, prompting urgent biotech caution. Anthropic CEO Amodei argues the dangers warrant immediate attention from the sector.

tecnologia|america.title: Researchers used Claude to hack OpenAI
tecnologia|america.summary: Researchers used Claude to hack into an OpenAI employee account and access sensitive GitHub data. The incident demonstrates vulnerabilities in AI system security protocols.

tecnologia|europa.title: Aragón se está llenando de centros de datos, así que la Universidad de Zaragoza ha lanzado 39 cursos para nutrir los datacenters
tecnologia|europa.summary: La Universidad de Zaragoza lanza 39 cursos nuevos para preparar profesionales en centros de datos. Aragón se está llenando de instalaciones de este tipo que demandan personal especializado.

tecnologia|europa.summary: El cofundador de WordPress enfrenta una rebelión dentro de su propia empresa. Cuatro de cada diez webs utilizan esta plataforma de creación de contenidos.

tecnologia|asia.summary: 台湾网络信息中心敦促企业将域名纳入安全管理，台湾DNSSEC部署率仅2.47%。企业应检视网站基础安全并利用健检服务了解防护状况。

tecnologia|asia.title: CISA發布首份網路誘餌實務指南，協助關鍵基礎設施及早偵測已入侵攻擊者
tecnologia|asia.summary: 美国网络安全基础设施安全局发布首份网络诱饵实务指南。该指南帮助关键基础设施通过欺敌技术及早发现已入侵的攻击者。

tecnologia|asia.title: Docker沙箱環境存在重大漏洞，攻擊者有機會讀取及竄改macOS主機檔案
